# SmartHomeLockControl

**Class:** `SmartHomeLockControl` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeDeviceControl.h"`

## What it is for

A lock with its battery and activity

## Overview

@brief Lock control widget A lock / unlock button, the lock's state and battery, and its recent activity, newest first.
